verdict.rationale: Paxos's own USDG docs say it publishes monthly reserve-composition reports and attestation reports, and that USDG is redeemable 1:1 for USD. That covers the reserve and attestation parts of the story. The pack says nothing about a yield or rewards program, its eligibility, or regulatory caveats, and gives no detail on what the reserves hold or who performs the attestations. Missing for 10: documentation of any yield/rewards program, eligibility criteria, plainly stated regulatory caveats, reserve detail beyond the existence of reports, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the economics of held stablecoins are documented — reserve composition, attestations, and any yield or rewards program with its eligibility and regulatory caveats stated plainly

citations.quote: Paxos publishes monthly reports on reserve composition as well as attestations reports
USDG is available for purchase and fully redeemable from Paxos on a one-to-one basis for US dollars (1 USDG = 1 USD).
